title: Zesty Tender Spanish Cacao Tapas Platter
description: A quick, aromatic tapas platter featuring sweet cacao, crispy tofu lardons, and fresh lime zest in a mason jar.
instructions: Press and cube 200g of firm tofu and set aside for marination.
In a bowl whisk 2 tbsp cacao powder, 1 tbsp maple syrup, 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp cumin, and 1 tsp sea salt with 1 tbsp olive oil to create a glaze.
Coat tofu cubes in glaze and let sit for 5 minutes.
Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a pan, add tofu lardons and fry until golden and crisp, then drain on paper towels.
Spread tofu cubes, tofu lardons, chopped almonds, and apricots into a mason jar, layering alternately.
Press the jar gently to compress ingredients, then add a few mint leaves and a lime wedge for brightness.
Refrigerate the jar for 10 minutes to allow flavors to meld.
Serve chilled with a squeeze of lime and an extra sprinkle of cacao powder.
Enjoy a zesty, tender Spanish tapas experience in a convenient mason jar.
